revision.main_change: RPY_IMU is primary; YAW_ONLY is baseline; camera centers fixed to measured RTK values

purpose: first paper on attitude calibration and practical flight-path selection; data collection protocol, not an executed simulation

coordinates.camera_optical: RDF: x right, y down, z forward
coordinates.rotation_matrix: R_WC maps optical column vectors to world
coordinates.heading_positive: clockwise about world up when viewed from above, from +Y toward +X
coordinates.heading_formula: R_WC(psi) = Rz_world(-psi) @ R_WC_nominal; radians in trigonometric functions
coordinates.full_attitude_parameters: phi = optical-forward roll; theta = elevation correction relative to nominal 20deg; psi = world heading. Do not substitute an undocumented library Euler order.
coordinates.px4_local_mapping: must discover and record world-to-PX4-local transform; origin may be vehicle spawn, not landing pad
coordinates.glide_definition: z_ref = D*tan(20deg), D=y; nominal vertical approach profile, not instantaneous 3D velocity angle during lateral motion

camera.yolo_weights: reuse existing file; record actual path and SHA256
camera.detector_confidence_nms_thresholds: discover existing settings and freeze before main campaign
camera.physical_pose_requirement: rotate rendered optical pose while holding optical centers fixed; verify actual Gazebo transforms, do not alter only estimator values

vehicle.dimensions_action: measure/read existing SDF meshes; do not infer dimensions from model name
vehicle.reference_definition_action: verify rigid transform to base_link and GNSS antenna in student repository
vehicle.synthetic_rtk_reference: same declared vehicle reference point as trajectory and GT; explicitly label simulated observation
vehicle.lever_arm_action: record actual existing model transform; unknown is null, not silently zero
vehicle.roll_pitch: determined by flight dynamics, never clamp to zero

motion.speed_profile: half-cosine acceleration for tr seconds, constant-speed cruise, half-cosine deceleration for tr seconds
motion.length_parameterization: arc length along 3D trajectory; not fixed s_dot
motion.main_window: science_start through science_end at reference duration T; acceleration/deceleration included; record dynamic early termination as performance outcome

environment.world_lighting_background: freeze existing world configuration and record hashes
environment.wind: keep existing setting, log it; do not silently add wind to force diversity
environment.rng_policy: reset each execution; request manifest seed; record which actual stochastic components accept it
environment.rng_unsupported_policy: label seed_effective=false; do not claim independent Monte Carlo flight trials; raw duplicate check required

capture.time_domain: Gazebo simulation time, with simulation epoch
capture.pair_policy: unique source-frame pairs; no reusing a source frame in multiple nominal pairs; save unmatched observations
capture.interpolation: positions linear at image time; orientation shortest-path quaternion SLERP; no extrapolation; max bracketing gap 0.04s
capture.raw_image_storage: lossless camera images in rosbag2 or equivalent lossless stream with frame-to-timestamp mapping
capture.overlays: optional visualization only, not a substitute for raw images
capture.detection_failures: retain all image records with explicit detection status and null coordinates; never encode missing bbox as (0,0)
capture.ideal_projection: diagnostic channel from synchronized GT and true camera pose; never pass to actual-YOLO estimator

camera_centers.main_value: fixed measured RTK optical-center coordinates, after known antenna-to-optical-center lever-arm transform
camera_centers.synthetic_measurement: C_meas_i = C_true_i + e_i; e_i sampled once per camera/MC trial and shared across calibration paths and V0 in the same rig/repetition/trial
camera_centers.covariance_use: store and propagate in Monte Carlo; not a position optimization prior or permission to move camera centers
camera_centers.unknown_lever_arm: record null and limitation; do not label antenna coordinates as optical center without a transform

RPY_IMU.roll_pitch: estimated with finite camera-mounted IMU priors, not locked

YAW_ONLY.roll_pitch: fixed at the same measured IMU prior means used to initialize RPY_IMU; never replace by true angles in this baseline

imu_prior.sensor: camera-mounted IMU; not drone body attitude
imu_prior.mean: noisy camera roll/pitch measurement, in the declared optical attitude parameterization
imu_prior.noise_policy: independent Gaussian roll/pitch measurement error, sampled once per camera/trial and held across calibration and evaluation; explicitly simulated
imu_prior.units: internal angles in radians, covariance in radians squared
imu_prior.cost: sum_i r_i.T @ inv(Sigma_IMU_i) @ r_i, r_i=[wrap(phi_i-mu_phi_i), theta_i-mu_theta_i]
imu_prior.zero_sigma_policy: only an explicitly labeled idealized fixed-angle control; never invert zero covariance or call it the main RPY_IMU experiment
imu_prior.mount_transform: record IMU-to-optical rotation; convert measured angles and covariance consistently

yaw_prior.use: initialization only; Y0..Y6 are fixed initial biases, not exact prior standard deviations
yaw_prior.rank_deficiency_policy: report conditioning, failure or prior dependence; do not silently add GT yaw or a true-pose constraint

comparison_matrix.paired_inputs: same initial camera attitude, camera RTK coordinates, IMU observations, image samples and random draws; same drone RTK observations for A/B only
comparison_matrix.latent_points: B/C may estimate drone positions; their trajectory unknowns are additional to camera attitude DOFs and never camera translation variables

reprocessing.bias_definition: reported initial heading minus true heading; constant for a calibration/evaluation trial, not white noise at every frame
reprocessing.roll_pitch_note: pitch about optical right, roll about optical forward; this formula defines order, not implicit Euler addition
reprocessing.rtk_noise_model: baseline iid Gaussian is explicitly idealized; extra shared-ENU bias trial N(0,diag(0.02^2,0.02^2,0.04^2)) drawn once and fixed across calibration/test; same drone RTK realization for A and B
reprocessing.pixel_noise_policy: synthetic point branch only for base pixel-noise sweep; actual YOLO branch uses actual detections without mandatory extra noise
reprocessing.camera_position_bias_policy: main uses measured, biased camera coordinates; draw once per camera/trial and share across paths/methods/calibration/evaluation; never optimize positions
reprocessing.timestamp_offset_definition: reported timestamp = true exposure/sample timestamp + offset; no content edits
reprocessing.timing_tests: shift drone RTK only, or right camera only, in separate tests; shift observed record timestamps before pairing, never GT truth
reprocessing.matched_sample_policy: report all-data performance plus an additional 200-pair time-stratified comparison; if fewer than 200 valid pairs, flag unmet sample count, do not duplicate frames or discard the run
reprocessing.main_control: G0, Y0..Y6, RPY_IMU primary versus YAW_ONLY baseline for A/B/C; fixed measured camera RTK centers; camera IMU sigma 0.02deg; drone RTK sigma xyz (0.02,0.02,0.04)m for A/B
reprocessing.ideal_control: YAW_IDEAL with true camera centers/roll/pitch and ideal drone RTK is a separate diagnostic; it does not replace the main noisy comparison
offline_stages: validate geometry and idealized estimator behavior
run paired main RPY_IMU versus YAW_ONLY comparisons on G0
run G1 with nominal zero initial heading and the same noisy position/IMU policy
extend one factor at a time on P0 and a path selected without V0 outcomes
reprocessing.G1_no_double_injection: primary G1 starts at nominal zero heading; do not add Y6 again
reprocessing.data_separation: truth used only by simulated-sensor producer and evaluator; estimators see an explicit input allowlist
reprocessing.C_prior_policy: fixed measured camera RTK centers; same finite camera IMU priors in RPY_IMU or fixed IMU means in YAW_ONLY; no main yaw penalty; never use drone RTK/GT or commanded reference trajectory as known 3D points
reprocessing.B_joint_requirement: shared latent drone points and RTK uncertainty; two independent objectives concatenated are not a new joint method

split_policy.development: G0 calibration flights only, plus geometric synthetic validation; select algorithm/settings without V0 errors
split_policy.final_test: all V0 flights locked until algorithms, hyperparameters and path selection are frozen
split_policy.G1_P4: predeclared representative S path, not claimed optimal; no adaptive substitution using final test results
split_policy.evaluation_pairing: same rig group and repetition; evaluate each calibration path on corresponding V0, reuse same test flight across methods
split_policy.evaluation_calibration_frozen: fix camera centers and calibrated rotations before V0; use V0 images only for drone position estimation, never recalibrate on V0
split_policy.selection_policy: until a numeric requirement is supplied report accuracy/time tradeoff and predict error from calibration uncertainty; no invented pass threshold
split_policy.limitation: 39 runs do not alone prove global path optimality, sensor-spec realism or field/helicopter performance

validity.retry_allowed: recorder failure, missing required streams, corrupt files, wrong fixed config, or infrastructure-caused launch/flight interruption; retain original attempt
validity.retry_rule: same run_id and requested seed, increment attempt_id; fix shared cause before continuing; two failed technical attempts trigger root-cause report
validity.performance_failures: keep and report detection/estimation/flight-control/dynamics failures when recording is intact; no rerun merely because performance is poor
validity.protocol_revisions: version and hash all changes; do not pool pre-change and post-change trials as identical

sources.existing_run: run11-final initial 122 cases plus supporting execution metadata
sources.student_local_repo: discover; never assume historical path still exists
